title: Cerium(III) Phosphinate and Cerium(IV) Phosphostibonate Acting as Catalysts for Mild, Selective Sulfoxidation

synthesis.procedure: Trityl-H-phosphinic acid (0.165 g, 0.536 mmol) was dissolved in methanol (60 mL) to give a clear solution, and CeCl3·7H2O (0.100 g, 0.268 mmol) was added at room temperature (2:1 ligand:Ce). After 1 h a white precipitate formed; stirring was continued for 12 h to complete precipitation. The precipitate was collected, washed thoroughly with methanol, dried, and crystallized from chloroform/toluene (1:1), left undisturbed for 1 week to give colorless block-shaped crystals. Isolated crystals were powdered and dried under high vacuum for 30 min before characterization.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirring at room temperature; crystallization from CHCl3/toluene (1:1)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Precipitate washed with methanol, dried, dissolved in chloroform/toluene (1:1) and left undisturbed for 1 week to afford colorless block-shaped crystals; crystals powdered and high-vacuum dried 30 min.

synthesis.procedure: The organostibonate–phosphonate proligand [(p-ClC6H4Sb)2(O)(t-BuPO3H)6] (0.05 g, 0.038 mmol) and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.066 g, 0.15 mmol) were dissolved in methanol (15 mL), followed by dropwise addition of 2,6-lutidine (0.1 mL). The clear solution was stirred for 2 h, transferred into a Teflon digestion bomb, heated at 150 °C for 16 h, and cooled slowly to room temperature over 36 h to give colorless block-shaped single crystals. Isolated crystals were powdered and dried under high vacuum for 30 min before characterization.
synthesis.temperature: 150 °C (solvothermal); cooled to room temperature over 36 h
synthesis.time: 2 h stirring; 16 h heating; 36 h cooling
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in Teflon digestion bomb
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow cooling of the methanol reaction mixture over 36 h to room temperature afforded colorless block-shaped single crystals; crystals powdered and high-vacuum dried 30 min.
